title: 751. Find Element Index in Matrix
description:

Find Element Index in Matrix
30
Easy
Topics
Problem Statement:
The first input is row_count(<10), the second input is column_count(<10), third the array elements are given and finally fourth input will be search element. The search element’s index should be printed as the output. If input is not found then print (-1, -1) 
Input Description:
Four inputs 
Output Description:
index position of the search element to printed for all the occurence in the input matrix 
Explanation:
in the matrix 2 is found in index (0, 1) 
Sample Input:
3 3
1 2 3
4 5 6
7 8 9
2 
Sample Output:
(0, 1)
